summary: Joseph Seeds Jr. of Denver, descending Capitol Peak after summiting, got off route near the K2 sub-summit and became stranded on unstable terrain northwest of the summit; texted a friend for help; a Mountain Rescue Aspen helicopter team flown in by a Colorado National Guard Black Hawk (HAATS) located him and flew him off the mountain. Thirsty and fatigued, otherwise uninjured; all rescuers out of the field by ~6:15 p.m.
responding_agency: Mountain Rescue Aspen; Colorado National Guard HAATS
notes: Source: 14ers.com forum thread (opened run 532) quoting Mountain Rescue Aspen's 2017-09-06 press release; corroborated by Getty Images editorial caption (Helen H. Richardson/Denver Post) naming Seeds and dating the Black Hawk search to 2017-09-06. Wednesday-verified.
